lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Fe2Zr2Co4O16 (FeZrCo2O8) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 24 atoms per unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Fe each adopt octahedral coordination with six O neighbors, while Zr is eight-coordinate with O and the O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by Co, Fe, and Zr. The neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Co and Fe octahedra, plus edge-sharing between Co octahedra.
